generator: Hand measurement of classic C:\Windows\regedit.exe popups (UI Automation rectangles plus screen-copy pixel analysis)

regedit.compatLayer: RunAsInvoker, set on the child process only
regedit.readOnly: Menus opened with Alt+letter, Down, Right and Escape. Only Alt+F4 closed the window. No value or key was changed.

dpi.note: Same 192 DPI as regedit-metrics.json. One DIP is two device pixels. Every px value below is a device pixel at 192 DPI.

method: Started regedit with __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker on the child, found the new RegEdit_RegEdit window, and held Local\BwcGuiTestLock while it ran.
Menu bar rectangles were read from UI Automation (MenuBar children) and match regedit-metrics.json exactly.
Each popup is a #32768 window. Its rectangle was read with Win32 GetWindowRect and its pixels were copied from the screen with Graphics.CopyFromScreen while it was open.
Item rectangles were read from UI Automation for the popup window. Separators are exposed as ControlType.Separator with height 13 px.
Ink extents, the background histogram, the separator line row, the check glyph, the submenu arrow, and the focus rectangle were read from the captured pixels.
Text widths were measured with TextRenderer at Segoe UI 24 px (9 pt at 192 DPI), with the mnemonic ampersand removed.

menuBar.note: Every item has the same 14 px padding on each side of its text, so the oracle rectangles are text width plus 28 px.

checkMark.measuredOn: View > Address Bar (checked on the reference machine)

popup.mnemonicUnderline: Shown on the bar and in every open popup after keyboard opening (Alt, F10, or a letter). The underline sits under the mnemonic letter.
popup.popupCornerShape: Square popup corners. The keyboard focus rectangle has rounded corners, about 3 px radius.
popup.popupWidth: Sized to the widest label plus the accelerator column. Measured popups: File 548 px, Edit 398 px, New 417 px, View 407 px, Help 401 px.

dipFormula: DIP = device px / 2 at 192 DPI. At another scale the classic value is px * scale / 2, and the BWC values are computed in DIP so they scale with the window.
